text:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem — we need explicit owners, Jira links, and QA acceptance criteria before we close the RCA. @Ravi @Lei can you claim primary owners?

Ravi Singh: I can pick up the fix (race in eviction). claiming https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-6781 — aiming for a PR by EOD Fri.

Sam K: also: add a small canary + regression test. I can own the test harness if someone spins up the ticket.

Lei Chen: happy to own QA acceptance and the canary roll plan. will draft acceptance steps and failure signals. cc @Maya for sign-off.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-03-14-Cache-Thrash — postmortem published (link: https://redwood.intranet/pm/2026-03-14-cache-thrash).

Maya Patel: thanks — let's capture RACI and firm due dates so follow-ups don't slip. propose: Ravi = R (owner), Maya = A (approver), Lei = C (QA), Sam = C/I (tests & monitoring). agree?

Ravi Singh: yes. timeline: patch + unit tests by 2026-03-20, integration + canary by 2026-03-25.

Sam K: ok I'll add the synthetic load job and canary config once JIRA-6782 exists. can we require 72h soak before promote? :thumbsup: 

Lei Chen: 72h soak makes sense. I'll add acceptance checklist + exact metrics. PR checklist should reference thresholds.

Maya Patel: writing the action list here — confirm and I'll create an epic to track.

```
Action items:
- JIRA-6781: Fix cache eviction race — owner: Ravi Singh — due: 2026-03-20 — R: Ravi, A: Maya, C: Lei, I: Sam
- JIRA-6782: Canary + regression test + soak — owner: Sam K — due: 2026-03-25 — R: Sam, A: Maya, C: Lei, I: Ravi
- JIRA-6783: QA acceptance criteria + runbook updates — owner: Lei Chen — due: 2026-03-22 — R: Lei, A: Maya, C: Ravi, I: eng-sre
```

Ravi Singh: confirmed JIRA-6781 created and linked in my branch. left a TODO for perf check.

Sam K: created JIRA-6782 and uploaded canary config template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-6782

Lei Chen: JIRA-6783 created with checklist, will DM Maya for final approval tomorrow.

Maya Patel: great — I'll open an epic and add label "recurring-pattern" so infra planning can pick it up. scheduling a 15m handoff on Mon to confirm owners and risks. if you need to swap, ping me before EOD. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: noted. also recommend we flag this pattern in quarterly reliability review so longer-term mitigations get prioritized.

Maya Patel: agreed — adding note to the epic.

oncall-bot: Reminder: follow-up review scheduled on 2026-03-27.

Ravi Singh: ack, will post progress updates in the Jira comments.

Lei Chen: ack.

Maya Patel: thanks team — closing the loop here.
